# graviteeam_application (Resource)

Manages a Gravitee AM Application

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_application" "example" {
  domain_id   = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  name        = "my-app"
  type        = "WEB"
  description = "My Web Application"

  oauth_settings {
    redirect_uris             = ["http://localhost:8080/callback"]
    post_logout_redirect_uris = ["http://localhost:8080/"]
    grant_types               = ["authorization_code", "refresh_token"]
    response_types            = ["code"]
    scopes                    = ["openid", "profile", "email"]
  }

  mfa_settings {
    enrollment = "OPTIONAL"
    challenge  = "REQUIRED"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain this application belongs to
- `name` (String) The name of the application
- `type` (String) The type of the application (WEB, NATIVE, BROWSER, SERVICE, RESOURCE_SERVER)

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the application
- `factors` (List of String) List of MFA factor IDs to associate with the application
- `identity_provider_rule` (Block List) Identity provider with selection rule for identifier-first login routing (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--identity_provider_rule))
- `identity_providers` (List of String) List of identity provider IDs to associate with the application
- `mfa_settings` (Block, Optional) MFA settings (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--mfa_settings))
- `oauth_settings` (Block, Optional) OAuth2/OIDC settings (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--oauth_settings))

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) The OAuth2 client ID (auto-generated by Gravitee AM)
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) The OAuth2 client secret (auto-generated by Gravitee AM)
- `id` (String) The ID of the application

<a id="nestedblock--identity_provider_rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `identity_provider_rule`

Required:

- `identity` (String) The identity provider ID
- `priority` (Number) Priority order (lower = higher priority)

Optional:

- `selection_rule` (String) EL expression for routing (e.g. {#request.params['username'][0].endsWith('@example.com')})


<a id="nestedblock--mfa_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mfa_settings`

Optional:

- `challenge` (String) MFA challenge type: OPTIONAL, REQUIRED, or CONDITIONAL
- `enrollment` (String) MFA enrollment type: OPTIONAL, REQUIRED, or CONDITIONAL


<a id="nestedblock--oauth_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `oauth_settings`

Optional:

- `access_token_validity_seconds` (Number) Access token lifetime in seconds
- `grant_types` (List of String) Allowed grant types
- `id_token_validity_seconds` (Number) ID token lifetime in seconds
- `post_logout_redirect_uris` (List of String) Allowed post-logout redirect URIs
- `redirect_uris` (List of String) Allowed redirect URIs
- `refresh_token_validity_seconds` (Number) Refresh token lifetime in seconds
- `response_types` (List of String) Allowed response types
- `scopes` (List of String) Allowed OAuth2/OIDC scopes (e.g. openid, profile, email)
